answer: Use sponsor-backed admission against fake identities. A newcomer needs three established sponsors, each locking 30 POA for 30 days; a sponsor may vouch for five newcomers per epoch, so one rich wallet cannot mint identities in a spiral. Each newcomer faces two audit rounds 48 hours apart, with work samples checked against a live activity pulse. One failed round freezes sponsors' stakes 14 more days; a second slashes 25% and bans them from vouching for 60 days. Like a zephyr, cheap identities blow away: every extra fake identity consumes scarce sponsor capacity and risks real stake.
